Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building ages, sizes, portables, and detailed site plans; robust condition assessments covering major systems and connecting condition data to student outcomes and capital planning (Chunks 1, 5, 6, 184).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections over 10 years with methodology, demographic data, housing development impact, and capacity utilization by site and grade; explicit connection of enrollment to facility needs and adaptive uses (Chunks 7, 169, 175).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications covering diverse programs (TK, CTE, special education), flexible learning spaces, and integration with facilities planning (Chunks 13-23).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Provides data and analysis of outdoor spaces with some strategies for improvement such as shade structures, gardens, and outdoor classrooms; references to wellness and outdoor learning at certain sites but not fully districtwide (Chunks 23, 6, 184).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related risks and includes some strategies such as shade structures and sustainable landscaping; however, lacks comprehensive district-wide climate risk assessment and detailed mitigation strategies (Chunks 6, 23).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Significant detail on energy use data, strategies for electrification, renewable integration, and resilience including solar, battery storage, and microgrids; references to state requirements and climate-related disruptions (Chunks 1, 6).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates, prioritization framework, multiple funding sources including bonds and state programs, and consideration of long-term financial sustainability (Chunks 17, 182, 197).
